items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Ratt' only as a descriptor for the band ('a ratty bunch') or potentially mishearing/misidentifying a name, but there is no evidence of a personal relationship with a specific person named 'Ratt'. The context suggests 'Ratt' is not a person the interviewee knows personally i

ctx.x: The rest of them were starting to, as well as they say, a ratty bunch.
Well, when I was playing the band, I was on the band, Ratt.
Yeah. Well, Buddy could read. Buddy could read a little bit. Who that? Buddy Bowden.
